summary:
PROJECT SUMMARY

ARES-BioSync – Autonomous Crew Health Monitoring System

ARES-BioSync is a web-based crew health monitoring platform designed to improve astronaut safety during long-duration space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard to monitor astronauts' health conditions and spacecraft environmental parameters.

The system displays important vital signs, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, and body temperature. It also monitors radiation exposure, cabin pressure, oxygen levels, and carbon dioxide concentration. Additional features include individual crew profiles, health status indicators, SANS monitoring, EVA readiness, and mission readiness assessment.

The platform uses an interactive dashboard to present simulated health data in an organized and user-friendly manner. It helps identify potential health risks and demonstrates autonomous health monitoring during communication delays with Earth.

ARES-BioSync demonstrates how web technologies and data visualization can support astronaut healthcare, mission safety, and future deep-space exploration.
details:
ARES-BioSync is creative because it combines astronaut healthcare, space technology, and web development into a single interactive platform. Instead of displaying only basic health information, it includes multiple specialized sections such as radiation monitoring, SANS assessment, EVA readiness, behaviour and sleep monitoring, and clinical protocols. It also includes LEO, Moon, and Mars mission options and demonstrates delayed communication with Earth. Its space-mission-inspired dashboard design makes complex health information easier to understand.

6. What factors did your team consider?

Our team considered the following factors while developing the project:

Astronaut Safety: Monitoring crew health and identifying possible risks.

Space Environment: Considering microgravity, radiation, and cabin environmental conditions.

Communication Delay: Designing the concept to support monitoring when Earth communication is delayed.

User Interface: Creating a simple, attractive, and user-friendly dashboard.

Data Accuracy: Presenting health parameters in a clear and organized manner.

Future Development: Considering integration with real-time sensors and advanced health monitoring technologies.
